data.title: What is METI-MC?
data.body: METI-MC is a management-consulting assessment and development platform. You take a set of assessments, get AI-scored results, a report, a personal AI explainer and a development roadmap. It is built for people who want to develop consulting capability, not a pass/fail exam.

data.title: How long does the assessment take?
data.body: Each assessment shows an expected time. Altogether the full set is roughly 60–90 minutes, and you don't have to do it in one sitting — your answers save automatically and you can continue on any device.

data.title: What's included in the paid report?
data.body: A paid assessment gives you a Summary of Findings. The Detailed Intelligence Report & Development Roadmap upgrade adds the full evidence-grounded breakdown of every competency, your values profile, your graded written and case responses, a personalised development roadmap, and the premium AI Results Explainer.

data.title: How much does it cost?
data.body: Prices are shown on the pricing page. There are two assessments and a bundle, plus the Detailed Report & Roadmap upgrade which you can buy after an assessment. Check the pricing page for current amounts.

data.title: How is my data used?
data.body: Your answers and uploads are used only to produce your own results and are private to you. You confirm consent when you register. The support chatbot you're using now has no access to any candidate's answers or scores — it only reads public help content.

data.title: What happens to my video?
data.body: If you record a video for the written-communication task, it is uploaded securely, stored privately and used only to score your response. Only you (and an administrator who supports your account) can access it.

data.title: Do I have to upload my CV?
data.body: Uploading your CV lets the platform pre-fill your profile — you always review and correct what it found before it's used. If you'd rather not upload, you can fill in your profile by hand.

data.title: How do I understand my results?
data.body: Open the Results page for your scores, and the Report page for your Summary of Findings. On the report and roadmap you can ask the AI Results Explainer questions about your own results — please sign in to see and ask about your results.

data.title: Can I retake an assessment?
data.body: Yes. You can reassess a module later without losing your earlier attempt, and see your progress before and after. Your roadmap suggests when to retake.

data.title: How do I contact support?
data.body: For anything this help can't answer — billing, account access, or a technical problem — contact the support team from your account page. If your question is about your own results, please sign in and use the AI Results Explainer on your report.
